name: Yousei
source: For the past few years, Kangai has been a wanderer, but his return to his hometown has triggered a series of deaths linked to his past. He joins a group of psychic teenagers who solve mysteries under the watchful eye of the government. In Yousei, he and his group are sent undercover to a local university where they must dig up the remains of a top secret experiment. Upon arrival, they discover the project lead missing, and an old acquaintance racing them for the same information.
translation: 這些年來，Kangai一直過著漂泊生活；如今他回到故鄉，卻引發了一連串與過去有關的死亡事件。他加入了一群受政府監視、專門解決神秘案件的超能力少年。在《Yousei》中，他和同伴們被派去當地一所大學臥底，調查一項絕密實驗的遺蹟。抵達後，他們發現專案負責人已經失蹤，而一位舊相識也在和他們搶同一份情報。
